---
name: First-use and integration feedback
about: Help improve installation, application integration and engine authoring
---

## Goal and environment
App or engine, language, OS/architecture, candidate hash, declared profile:

## First attempt
What did you try without help? Which documentation and command did you use?
Time to a checked solution, first blocker, and any assistance received:

## Integration
What input or engine did you change? What succeeded? What failed or was unclear?
Include only synthetic data and sanitized errors.

## Evidence boundary
Indicate which steps actually ran: download / install / solve / checker /
input change / own app / own engine. A page view is not a successful installation.
